behavioral_signatures: Python packages that execute destructive shell commands (e.g., 'rm -rf /')
Runtime download and execution of remote binaries from hardcoded URLs
Unusual filesystem access patterns (mass deletion, access to root directories)
file_indicators: Presence of code invoking 'os.system' with destructive arguments
References to remote payload URLs in package source
Temporary files such as '/tmp/payload.bin' being created and executed
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests to suspicious or untrusted domains (e.g., 'malicious-remote-url')
Unexpected downloads of executable files during package import or runtime
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Python packages that attempt to execute shell commands with destructive arguments, especially those that delete large portions of the filesystem. Flag packages that download and execute remote binaries at runtime, particularly from hardcoded or untrusted URLs. Use EDR or file integrity monitoring to detect mass file deletions or the creation and execution of suspicious binaries in temporary directories. Network monitoring should alert on outbound connections to known malicious domains or unexpected payload downloads.
